name: Wind-flattened juniper 014
modifier: a bird nest in its crown
glow_concept: light in the crack at its root
prompt: a tough windbent shrub whose trunk kinks hard sideways then turns up, its bare gripping roots clenched around a single small stone at its base, an organic RAGGED IRREGULAR silhouette with leaves and strands trailing off unevenly at the edges and a torn uneven bottom — never a rectangle, never a straight edge, never a filled panel or square sheet, no hard border of any kind — ONLY the plant itself, isolated on a fully transparent background, NO rock, NO cliff, NO stone wall, NO mountain, NO ground, nothing behind it, wind-flattened juniper, a bird nest in its crown, roughly six feet tall, human height, self-emissive at night, softly radiating light: light in the crack at its root

placement.note: ONE SCENERY PIXEL IS ONE PLAYER PIXEL. world_px_height IS the art's own alpha bbox height, so scenery is placed into the world at 1:1 exactly as the avatar is (setScale(1)) and the two share one pixel grid. The CAMERA still zooms the whole scene — that is uniform and correct; what must never happen is scenery being resampled on its own, against the player. world_height_m is what the art reads as beside a 87px character; declared_height_m is what it was once declared to be, and a gap between them means the ART is the wrong size.

light.reference: the spawn bonfire is 1.0 (radius 7); strength 0 is no light
